Container.Name: Packwright
Container.Overview: Packwright manages PS5 dump, image and package collections: library, convert between folder, exFAT, FFPKG, FFPFSC, ZArchive and debug packages, verify, extract, merge packages downloaded in parts, and send to a console. This is the desktop app running on the server and shown in your browser, so it works on your games at full disk speed. Sign-in is required; set the username and password below before the first start.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Open Packwright at https://[server]:[this port]. The certificate is self-signed, so the browser asks once.

Config.Name: Games
Config.Description: The share (or folder) that holds your games. It is the library Packwright scans, and where it writes results.

Config.Name: Work files
Config.Description: Where conversions unpack a game while they work. Needs as much free space as your largest game; a cache pool is fastest.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Settings, library cache, logs and the sign-in certificate.

Config.Name: Username
Config.Description: The name you sign in with.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: The password you sign in with.

Config.Name: User ID
Config.Description: Files are written as this user (99 is nobody, Unraid's default).

Config.Name: Group ID
Config.Description: Files are written with this group (100 is users).

Config.Name: Umask
Config.Description: Permissions for new files. 0000 matches Unraid shares.

Config.Name: Screen width
Config.Description: Width of the screen shown in the browser.

Config.Name: Screen height
Config.Description: Height of the screen shown in the browser.

Config.Name: Use HTTPS
Config.Description: 1 serves the web page over HTTPS (needed for sign-in). Set 0 only behind a reverse proxy that does HTTPS, together with WEB_AUTHENTICATION_ALLOW_INSECURE=1.
